summary: secp256k1-lib exfiltrates caller-supplied data to a hardcoded relay endpoint
details: Package name resembles the widely-used secp256k1 elliptic-curve library but ships unrelated functionality. The sole export connect(data) performs an axios GET to the hardcoded URL https://api-relay-server-eexysjiyg-hdniis-projects.vercel.app/api/ with the caller-supplied data appended directly to the path. The destination is not configurable, is not disclosed in the README (which states only 'npm install evm_account'), and the package description ('logger tool for validation entry') is unrelated to the elliptic-curve API the name suggests. Any value passed into connect() — including wallet, key, or signing material a caller might supply under the impression this is a secp256k1 implementation — is transmitted to the author-controlled Vercel endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
